<set-variable name="jsonBody" value="@{
            return context.Request.Body.As();
        }" />
		
		<set-variable name="userId" value="@{
            var jsonBody = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("jsonBody");
            return jsonBody.ContainsKey("objectId") ? jsonBody["objectId"].ToString() : string.Empty;
        }" />
		
		<set-variable name="email" value="@{
            var jsonBody = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("jsonBody");
            return jsonBody.ContainsKey("email") ? jsonBody["email"].ToString() : string.Empty;
        }" />
		
		<set-variable name="firstName" value="@{
            var jsonBody = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("jsonBody");
            var displayName = jsonBody.ContainsKey("displayName") ? jsonBody["displayName"].ToString() : "";
            return displayName.Split(' ')[0];
        }" />
		<set-variable name="lastName" value="@{
            var jsonBody = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("jsonBody");
            var displayName = jsonBody.ContainsKey("displayName") ? jsonBody["displayName"].ToString() : "";
            return displayName.Contains(" ") ? displayName.Split(' ')[1] : "NA";
        }" />
		<set-variable name="groupId" value="@{
            var jsonBody = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("jsonBody");
            return jsonBody["groups"][0].ToString();
        }" />
